# jamfplatform_pro_vpp_invitation (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro VPP invitation by ID or name. Exactly one selector must be supplied.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Jamf lists this under **Platform environment** scope (preferred for new integrations) or **Tenant** scope. You choose an integration's scope when you create it in Jamf Account, and cannot change it afterwards. The provider names the scopes it accepts when you configure it, and for a few families that is wider than Jamf lists here. Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| App lifecycle management | Volume purchasing | Read | `volume-purchasing-locations` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_vpp_invitation" "by_id" {
  id = "2"
}

data "jamfplatform_pro_vpp_invitation" "by_name" {
  name = "Volume Purchasing Self Service"
}

output "vpp_invitation_distribution_method" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_vpp_invitation.by_name.distribution_method
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Invitation ID. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) Invitation name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `auto_register_managed_users` (Boolean) Auto-register Managed Apple ID users.
- `distribution_method` (String) Distribution method.
- `invitation_usages` (Attributes List) Read-only per-user registration status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invitation_usages))
- `message` (String) Email message (email mode).
- `require_login` (Boolean) Require login (email mode).
- `scope` (Attributes) User-based scope. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope))
- `sender_email_address` (String) Sender email address (email mode).
- `sender_name` (String) Sender display name (email mode).
- `subject` (String) Email subject (email mode).
- `vpp_account_id` (String) VPP account ID.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--invitation_usages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invitation_usages`

Read-Only:

- `email_address` (String) User email address.
- `id` (String) Usage record ID.
- `last_action_date_epoch` (String) Last action timestamp (epoch ms).
- `last_action_date_utc` (String) Last action timestamp (UTC).
- `name` (String) User name.
- `status` (String) Registration status.
- `vpp_account` (String) VPP account name.


<a id="nestedatt--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope`

Read-Only:

- `exclusions` (Attributes) Scope exclusions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope--exclusions))
- `limitations` (Attributes) Scope limitations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope--limitations))
- `targets` (Attributes) Scope targets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope--targets))

<a id="nestedatt--scope--exclusions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope.exclusions`

Read-Only:

- `directory_service_user_group_names` (Set of String) Directory-service user group names.
- `jss_user_group_ids` (Set of String) Jamf Pro user group IDs.
- `jss_user_ids` (Set of String) Jamf Pro user IDs.


<a id="nestedatt--scope--limitations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope.limitations`

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--scope--targets"></a>

Read-Only:
